title: A&C Sportfishing Charters

services.name: Charter Boat
services.desc: If you're in the Cleveland or Lorain area and looking for the best fishing charters for Lake Erie walleye, perch or steelhead, A&C Sportfishing Charters out of Lorain is a great choice. Captain Alex lives in the Cleveland area and runs his A&C Sportfishing charters out of Oasis Marinas at Port Lorain in Lorain, Ohio. With Oasis Marina's location right off Lakeside Avenue in Lorain, meeting fishing charters for the day is a breeze. Only 30 minutes from Cleveland's west-side suburbs (Westlake, Bay Village, Rocky River, Lakewood, N. Olmsted) and under 15 minutes from Avon, Avon Lake, Sheffield, Elyria and Amherst. Oasis Marinas in Lorain is a convenient starting point to your Lake Erie charter

gap: Prices, hours and eligibility are not copied here yet. We will ask when you request.
blurb: Capt. Alex’s 29’ Baha Sportfish boat was built to dominate the lake. Her ample deck space lets you all fish at once while dipsy divers and planer boards bring hard-to-reach fish. She has a private restroom on board for spending a full day on the lake. She has everything you’ll need for some awesome angling. All bait, rods, gear, ice for fish
